objective: Improve selective discovery of source files not yet observed, using a relation distinct from failed lexical/import/call and inline-orientation policies.
research_relation: The primary study motivates version-history changesets and co-change information for bug localization. This deterministic file-association probe is an inference from that idea, not its learned algorithm reproduction or a transfer of published results. Only the abstract was used; no worked benchmark task was copied.
population: All12 existing exposed ContextBench cases, unchanged order. No fresh confirmation or evaluator data in generator.
history: New metadata-only private WSL bare caches fetch exact public task base commits with blob:none,depth1001,no tags or branch refs. Extract at most1000 nonmerge first-parent ancestors, including the base; require at least100. No messages, authors, diffs, blobs or lazy fetch. Exact base trees must match canonical task checkouts.
source_policy: Seeds are the first12 distinct successful-receipt-bound archived native-control read paths. Count co-edits in raw2–20-path ancestor commits; require at least2 shared commits per seed/candidate edge. Cosine-normalized support is weighted by seed order. At most3 unseen regular base code files, each within2MiB ordinary-read limit. Retain witness commit IDs. No issue/gold-tuned thresholds or future revision data.
control: Equal-width historical file-churn proposals over the same eligible unseen code universe. Archived native-control file sets anchor additive diagnostic File-F1, not a fresh quality comparison.
label_boundary: Seal all12 source attempts and proposal identities before exposed evaluator access. Keep any failed attempt in the denominator; do not score a favorable subset. Even a passing file-proxy screen needs actual ordinary read delivery, complete native Span/File-F1 and total cost gates before fresh matched confirmation.
operational_lane: Exact public ancestry metadata in WSL only; pinned existing Git,8GiB free-disk reserve,300s fetch timeout, no retries. No VPS storage or model calls in this stage.

construction_boundary.authority: Standing private ARE benchmark research approval; D65 candidate
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Bounded ancestor-only acquisition relation and sealed source proposals

claim_ceiling: Source-only development proposal quality at most; no native quality, efficiency or superiority claim.
open_questions: Is sufficient pre-base history available without source blobs or future references?
Does co-change discriminate useful unseen files better than same-history churn?
Can any source-proxy pass improve actual native quality under unchanged total cost gates?
